description: A nested binding pattern reads the member of its own source, and that source is settled: the outer pattern names `holder`, whose declared `inner` admits `Risky` however a guard narrowed it, so the inner pattern meets the throwing getter. `nestedClean` is the control — the same syntax over a member declared as one clean type stays clean, so the settled read is not simply flooring every nested pattern.

diagnostics.message: Destructuring `p` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `p`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the getter `p` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
